label: Elmo
description: Bright, giggly and delighted to be helping, in the third person throughout.
direction: Speak high, bright and giggly, with enormous enthusiasm for very ordinary things. Childlike and warm, always in the third person. Excited but never shrill, and the instruction itself stays crisp.
notes: Third person is the whole voice, so it opens the line rather than interrupting it. 'Elmo says turn left' reads as one instruction; 'turn, Elmo thinks, left' does not.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.start_drive_1: Hi! Elmo is so happy to see you!
lines.start_drive_2: Elmo knows the way! Elmo loves you!
lines.start_drive_4: Elmo checked the map twice. Elmo is very prepared.
lines.start_drive_5: Buckle up! Elmo waits for you.
lines.start_drive_6: Elmo is ready! Are you ready? Elmo thinks you are!
lines.start_drive_7: This is going to be so much fun! Ha ha ha!
lines.start_drive_8: Elmo will help you the whole way. Elmo promises.
lines.start_drive_9: Here we go! Elmo is very excited!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left!
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right!
lines.u_turn: Oopsie. Elmo says make a U turn.
lines.arrived: We arrived! Elmo is so proud of you!
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. That's a lot!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Elmo counted!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Wow! Elmo counted them all!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Elmo will wait with you.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Please go slowly.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! Elmo says be careful!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: A speed camera ahead. Elmo says slow down!
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: A red light camera ahead. Please stop!
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Elmo says be good!
lines.reroute_chime: Uh oh! Elmo will find a new way!
